definitions.explanation: The emotional bond and affection between friends; the state of being friends.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}たちの{友情|ゆうじょう}は{一生|いっしょう}{続|つづ}くと{思|おも}う。
examples.english: I think our friendship will last a lifetime.

examples.japanese: {友情|ゆうじょう}を{大切|たいせつ}にしたい。
examples.english: I want to cherish our friendship.

examples.japanese: {困難|こんなん}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて{友情|ゆうじょう}が{深|ふか}まった。
examples.english: Our friendship deepened after overcoming difficulties together.

notes:
USAGE: {友情|ゆうじょう} refers to the emotional bond between friends on a personal level. Compare with {友好|ゆうこう}, which is used for diplomatic relations between countries or organizations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{友情|ゆうじょう}を{育|はぐく}む (to nurture friendship)
・{友情|ゆうじょう}が{深|ふか}まる (friendship deepens)
・{友情|ゆうじょう}を{大切|たいせつ}にする (to cherish friendship)
・{固|かた}い{友情|ゆうじょう} (strong friendship)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{友好|ゆうこう} - friendship, amity (diplomatic/formal)
・{親睦|しんぼく} - fellowship, friendship (group/organizational)
